project.name: PantauCukur (Barberi Backend)
project.description: AI-powered barber shop occupancy detection and session management system with real-time WebSocket updates

architecture.overview: Monolithic Django application with integrated AI service for real-time chair occupancy detection and session management

django_backend.description: Handles REST API endpoints, WebSocket connections, and database operations

ai_engine.description: Computer vision service using YOLOv8-Pose for person detection, keypoint estimation, and ROI-based occupancy tracking

real_time_layer.description: WebSocket connection for live dashboard updates and status notifications

redis_cache.description: In-memory cache for sharing camera frames between AI Engine and Django processes

architecture.communication_flow: AI Engine → Redis (frame cache) → Django REST API → Database → WebSocket → Frontend Dashboard

models.py.description: Database models including BarberSession with scoring fields

views.py.description: API endpoints for session management, scoring, and summary data

consumers.py.description: WebSocket consumer for real-time updates with confidence scores

services/.description: AI and network services (refactored into specialized modules)

detector.py.description: YOLOv8-Pose based person detector with multi-person keypoint estimation and occupancy tracking (refactored, ~150 lines, coordinates pipeline only)
responsibilities: Initialize YOLO model and ByteTrack
Orchestrate detection → tracking → scoring pipeline
Coordinate between specialized managers
Draw UI overlay

state_machine.py.description: Session lifecycle management with timeout detection
responsibilities: Manage IDLE → PENDING → ACTIVE → ENDING → IDLE transitions
Track state duration and timers per chair
Maintain score history for confirmation window
Auto-transition to ENDING on timeout (5 minutes)
Return status_changed flag for integration with main.py

scoring_engine.py.description: 4-component scoring calculation (Posture 20%, Hand Activity 35%, Temporal 25%, Person Count 20%)
responsibilities: Calculate Posture Score using posture classifier
Calculate Hand Activity Score (barber-filtered)
Calculate Temporal Score based on duration
Calculate Person Count Score
Combine scores with weights from .env
Return total score + breakdown
Classify person as SITTING or STANDING
Use 3 signals: area ratio, chair presence, temporal consistency
Voting system to combine signals
Configurable thresholds from .env

hand_activity.py.description: Hand activity points calculation with barber filtering and hybrid head detection
responsibilities: Calculate hand activity points per frame (0-5)
Filter to only count barber (not customer)
Identify barber by STANDING posture + proximity to chair
Hybrid head detection: face bbox → nose → shoulder average
Check: hand above head, near head, fast movement, at side

track_manager.py.description: Trajectory & data management with automatic cleanup
responsibilities: Maintain trajectories per track_id
Maintain posture history per track_id
Maintain hand activity history per track_id
Maintain previous keypoints for speed calculation
Track last seen frame for each track_id
Cleanup inactive tracks (>60 seconds)
Identify barber vs customer for each chair

roi_manager.py.description: ROI & occupancy management with anti-flickering smoothing
responsibilities: Maintain ROI list per chair
Update ROIs
Check occupancy (person in ROI)
Anti-flickering smoothing (threshold_frames)
Count persons in ROI
Stable status management

utils.py.description: Helper functions for ROI management, configuration, and matching

network.py.description: Network communication with Django backend including scoring data

main.py.description: Main AI engine entry point with state machine integration
responsibilities: Load ROI config and initialize detector
Connect to camera stream
Main loop: read frame → process_ai() → handle session_data
Check status_changed flag from state machine
Send full session updates to Django via network
Heartbeat: send keepalive every 30 seconds
Graceful shutdown with cleanup

files.settings.py: Django settings with Channels and CORS configuration

fields.is_valid: BooleanField - True if duration > MIN_VALID_DURATION and score >= SCORING_THRESHOLD
fields.tracking_data: JSONField - per-frame tracking metrics and session data
fields.last_heartbeat: DateTimeField - last update timestamp (for timeout detection)
fields.timeout_reason: CharField - reason if session ended by timeout (nullable)

POST /api/session/start/.description: Start a new session with scoring data
POST /api/session/start/.side_effects: Creates BarberSession with scoring fields, triggers WebSocket update

POST /api/session/end/.description: End active session with scoring data
POST /api/session/end/.side_effects: Updates BarberSession with scoring fields, triggers WebSocket update

POST /api/session/update/.side_effects: Updates session status, triggers WebSocket update

POST /api/session/heartbeat/.description: Keepalive endpoint to prevent session timeout

GET /api/session/{id}/detail/.description: Get detailed session with confidence breakdown

GET /api/camera/frame/.description: Get latest camera frame as base64 JPEG with current ROIs

INITIAL_CONNECTION.data: Full summary data for dashboard initialization

anti_flickering.description: Requires 5 consecutive frames before status changes to prevent flickering

steps: AI Engine captures video frame from IP camera
YOLOv8-Pose detects persons and keypoints in frame
ByteTrack tracks persons with unique IDs
Detector compares person boxes with defined ROIs
Status change triggers API call to Django with scoring data
Django updates database and broadcasts via WebSocket

state_machine: IDLE → PENDING: 2 persons detected for 30 seconds
ACTIVE → ENDING: timeout after 5 minutes no update
start: AI detects 2 persons in chair area
After scoring threshold met, transitions to ACTIVE
New BarberSession record created with scoring fields
WebSocket broadcast sent to all connected clients
end: AI detects person(s) left or score drops below threshold
Session marked valid if duration > 180s and score ≥ 70
WebSocket broadcast sent to all connected clients
timeout: WebSocket broadcast sent to all connected clients

async_considerations.description: WebSocket consumer is async, database operations must use database_sync_to_async decorator
async_considerations.performance_concern: Avoid sending full history; limit summary results to 10

ai_engine_notes.performance: AI processing runs every frame (no skip) since YOLO-Pose provides both detection and keypoints in a single inference
ai_engine_notes.network_timeout: API calls have 0.5s timeout to prevent AI engine freeze if Django server is down
ai_engine_notes.refactoring: detector.py split into 8 specialized modules for maintainability

fixes_applied: Memory leak: Track cleanup every 300 frames, remove tracks inactive >60s
False standing: Multi-signal posture detection (area ratio + temporal)
Hand activity: Filter to only barber (standing + proximity to chair)
Head detection: Hybrid method (face bbox → nose → shoulders)
State machine integration: main.py now processes session_data
Session timeout: Watchdog timer auto-ends sessions after 5 minutes
future_improvements: Convert main.py functions into a class-based App for multiple camera support
Add Redis channel layer for production scaling

testing.http_testing: core/test.http file with REST Client compatible requests
test_scenarios: Barber gets tool 5 sec → remains ACTIVE
Customer playing phone → not counted as hand activity
AI crash → session auto-ends after 5 min timeout

deployment_notes.production: Must switch to Redis channel layer with `channels_redis`

common_issues.network_failure: AI engine continues running even if Django server is down
common_issues.session_validation: Sessions are valid if duration > 180s AND score ≥ 70
common_issues.websocket_initialization: Client must handle INITIAL_CONNECTION and STATUS_UPDATE messages differently
common_issues.memory_leak: Fixed with TrackManager cleanup every 300 frames
common_issues.hand_activity: Fixed with barber filtering (customers not counted)
common_issues.session_timeout: Fixed with watchdog timer (5 min auto-end)

frontend_integration.state_management: Maintain local chair status state and update from WebSocket messages
